summary_zh: 人类首个掠过月球的探测器，因错过撞击成为首颗环绕太阳的人造天体。
summary_en: First spacecraft to fly by the Moon; missed impact and became the first artificial object in heliocentric orbit.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 首次拍到月球背面照片，让人类第一次看到月球永远背向地球的一面。
summary_en: Returned the first images of the far side of the Moon, never before seen by humans.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 人类首个金星探测器，途中失联，仍是史上首个掠过金星的人造物体。
summary_en: First Venus probe; contact lost en route, yet became the first human-made object to fly past Venus.

source: NASA 'Mercury Crewed Flights Summary'; Wikipedia 'Project Mercury'
summary_en: Gus Grissom's successful suborbital flight; the capsule sank after splashdown when its hatch blew.
summary_zh: 格里索姆的亚轨道飞行成功，但返回舱溅落后舱门意外炸开，飞船沉入大西洋。

source: Wikipedia 'Vostok programme'; 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Gherman Titov orbited 17 times over a full day, the second human in space.
summary_zh: 季托夫绕地17圈、飞行超1天，成为第二位进入太空的人类。

source: NASA 'Mercury Crewed Flights Summary'; Wikipedia 'Project Mercury'
summary_en: John Glenn became the first American to orbit Earth, completing three orbits.
summary_zh: 格伦成为首位进入地球轨道的美国人，绕地三圈，飞行近5小时。

source: NASA 'Mercury Crewed Flights Summary'; Wikipedia 'Project Mercury'
summary_en: Scott Carpenter repeated Glenn's three-orbit flight, confirming Mercury capsule performance.
summary_zh: 卡彭特重复格伦的轨道飞行，验证水星飞船性能，绕地三圈。

source: Wikipedia 'Vostok programme'; 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Nikolayev flew simultaneously with Vostok 4, the first dual-spacecraft formation.
summary_zh: 尼古拉耶夫与东方4号同时在轨，开创双飞船编队飞行。

source: Wikipedia 'Vostok programme'; 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Popovich flew in coordination with Vostok 3, closing to within 6.5 km.
summary_zh: 波波维奇与东方3号协同飞行，两船最近时相距仅6.5公里。

name_zh: 水星-大力神8号（西格玛7号）
source: NASA 'Mercury Crewed Flights Summary'; Wikipedia 'Project Mercury'
summary_en: Wally Schirra flew six orbits, then the longest U.S. crewed spaceflight.
summary_zh: 施艾拉完成6圈轨道飞行，是当时美国最长的载人航天飞行。
人类首个火星探测器，途中失联，未能传回任何火星近距离探测数据。
summary_en: First Mars probe; communications lost en route, returning no close-range Mars data.

source: NASA 'Mercury Crewed Flights Summary'; Wikipedia 'Project Mercury'
summary_en: Gordon Cooper's 22-orbit, 34-hour solo flight closed Project Mercury.
summary_zh: 库珀单人绕地22圈、34小时，为水星计划收官，验证长期飞行能力。

source: Wikipedia 'Vostok programme'; 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Bykovsky's nearly 5-day solo flight remains the longest solo orbital flight.
summary_zh: 贝科夫斯基单人飞行近5天，至今仍是单人最长轨道飞行纪录。

summary_en: NASA's first successful Ranger probe; returned 4,308 close-up lunar photos before impacting the Moon.
summary_zh: NASA首个成功的徘徊者探测器，撞击月球前发回4308张月面特写照片。

source: Wikipedia 'Voskhod programme'; 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: First three-person crew; Komarov's team flew without spacesuits in a modified capsule.
summary_zh: 首次三人乘组上天，科马罗夫等三人不穿航天服挤进改装飞船。

summary_en: Mars flyby probe lost at launch when its shroud failed to jettison; never left Earth orbit.
summary_zh: 火星飞越探测器，因整流罩未能分离而发射失败，未能离开地球轨道。

summary_en: First successful Mars flyby; returned 21 close-up photos revealing a cratered, Moon-like Mars.
summary_zh: 首个成功飞越火星的探测器，发回21张火星特写，揭示火星荒凉环形山面貌。

summary_en: First crewed Gemini flight; Grissom and Young demonstrated orbital maneuvering.
summary_zh: 双子星首次载人飞行，格里索姆与杨完成轨道机动，验证变轨能力。

summary_en: Cooper and Conrad's nearly 8-day flight set a duration record for the Moon program.
summary_zh: 库珀与康拉德飞行近8天，打破载人飞行时长纪录，为登月验证耐力。
首个抵达另一颗行星表面的人造物，进入金星大气层后失联并撞击。
summary_en: First human-made object to reach another planet's surface; lost contact during atmospheric entry.
Borman and Lovell's nearly 14-day flight proved humans could endure a Moon round trip.
summary_zh: 博尔曼与洛弗尔飞行近14天，创时长纪录，证明登月往返可行。

summary_en: Schirra and Stafford achieved the first space rendezvous with Gemini 7.
summary_zh: 施艾拉与斯塔福德与双子星7号实现人类首次太空交会。

summary_en: Armstrong made the first space docking; a thruster fault forced an emergency return.
summary_zh: 阿姆斯特朗完成人类首次太空对接，但飞船翻滚，被迫紧急返回。
人类发射的首个月球人造卫星，首次从月球轨道传回科学探测数据。
summary_en: First spacecraft to orbit the Moon, returning the first science data from lunar orbit.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_en: First US lunar soft lander; returned over 11,000 photos and proved the soil could support a crewed lander.
summary_zh: 美国首个月球软着陆探测器，传回上万张月面照片，为阿波罗登月选址铺路。

summary_en: Failed Agena docking attempt; Cernan completed a difficult spacewalk.
summary_zh: 斯塔福德与塞尔南尝试与目标飞行器对接未果，塞尔南完成太空行走。

summary_en: Young and Collins docked twice with Agena; Collins retrieved equipment on EVA.
summary_zh: 杨与柯林斯两次对接阿金纳，柯林斯出舱取回实验装置。

summary_en: First lunar orbiter mapping mission; photographed the Moon to select Apollo landing sites.
summary_zh: 首个月球轨道测绘探测器，拍摄月面照片，为阿波罗计划挑选着陆地点。

summary_en: Conrad and Gordon set a crewed altitude record of 1,369 km and made the first direct reentry.
summary_zh: 康拉德与戈登创下1369公里载人飞行高度纪录，并完成首次直接再入。

summary_en: Lovell and Aldrin completed all planned objectives, closing Project Gemini.
summary_zh: 洛弗尔与奥尔德林完成计划全部目标，为双子星计划画上圆满句号。

source: Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Komarov's maiden Soyuz flight ended in a parachute failure and fatal crash landing.
summary_zh: 科马罗夫首飞新型联盟飞船，降落伞故障导致返回舱坠毁，航天员牺牲。
首次直接测量金星大气，确认其主要成分为二氧化碳且不存在磁场。
summary_en: First direct measurements of Venus's atmosphere, confirming it is mostly carbon dioxide.
Venus flyby probe that measured the Venusian atmosphere and confirmed its crushing, hot environment.
summary_zh: 金星飞越探测器，测量金星大气与磁场，证实金星表面高温高压环境。

summary_en: First crewed Apollo flight, validating the Block II CSM with the first live TV from space.
summary_zh: 阿波罗首次载人飞行，验证指令服务舱性能，并首次从太空直播电视。

summary_en: First humans to leave Earth orbit and circle the Moon, completing ten lunar orbits.
summary_zh: 人类首次离开地球轨道，绕月10圈，平安夜播出创世记朗读。
金星大气探测器，下降53分钟传回大气成分、压力与温度的测量数据。
summary_en: Venus atmospheric probe that transmitted composition, pressure and temperature data for 53 minutes.

summary_zh: 与金星5号成对发射升空，进一步确认了金星大气的高温高压环境。
summary_en: Twin of Venera 5; further confirmed Venus's extreme high-temperature, high-pressure atmosphere.

source: Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Shatalov launched solo and docked with Soyuz 5 for the first crew transfer between ships.
summary_zh: 沙塔洛夫单人升空，与联盟5号对接，实现首次两船乘员太空转移。

source: Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Volynov's crew launched; two cosmonauts spacewalked over to Soyuz 4 for return.
summary_zh: 沃雷诺夫等三人升空，两名乘员太空行走转移至联盟4号返回。

summary_en: Mars flyby probe; with Mariner 7 returned about 200 photos of the Martian surface.
summary_zh: 火星飞越探测器，与水手7号组成双星任务，发回约200张火星照片。

summary_en: First crewed test of the Lunar Module in Earth orbit, including rendezvous and EVA.
summary_zh: 首次在地球轨道测试登月舱，完成交会对接与舱外活动服试验。

summary_en: Mars flyby probe; paired with Mariner 6, observed the south polar cap and atmospheric composition.
summary_zh: 火星飞越探测器，与水手6号编队飞行，观测火星南极冠与大气成分。

summary_en: Lunar landing dress rehearsal; the LM descended to 15 km above the surface.
summary_zh: 登月彩排，登月舱降至距月面15公里，验证全部登月流程。

summary_en: First human Moon landing; Armstrong and Aldrin walked in the Sea of Tranquility.
summary_zh: 人类首次登月，阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林在静海留下足迹。

summary_en: Precision landing in the Ocean of Storms; two moonwalks and Surveyor 3 parts retrieved.
summary_zh: 精确着陆于风暴洋，回收测量员3号部件，开展两次月面行走。

summary_en: An oxygen tank explosion aborted the landing; the crew looped the Moon and returned safely.
summary_zh: 氧气罐爆炸迫使放弃登月，乘组绕月一圈后靠登月舱救生平安返回。

source: CNSA：中国第一颗人造卫星 东方红一号（2023-04-20；停止发射信号日期，不等于离轨日期）
summary_en: China's first artificial satellite, launched by a Long March 1; it broadcast the song 'The East Is Red', making China the fifth nation to independently orbit a satellite. It stopped transmitting in 1970; remaining in orbit does not mean operational.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗人造地球卫星，用长征一号发射并播送《东方红》乐曲，使中国成为第五个独立发射卫星的国家。 卫星早已停止发射信号，仍然在轨不等于仍在工作。

source: Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Nikolayev and Sevastyanov's nearly 18-day flight set a Soviet duration record.
summary_zh: 尼古拉耶夫与谢瓦斯季亚诺夫飞行近18天，创当时苏联时长纪录。
首次无人月球采样返回，带回101克月壤，返回舱在哈萨克斯坦着陆。
summary_en: First robotic lunar sample return, bringing 101 g of regolith back to Earth.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 搭载人类首辆月球车“月球车1号”，在月面行驶10.5公里工作322天。
summary_en: Delivered Lunokhod 1, the first planetary rover, which drove 10.5 km over 322 days.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_en: Shepard and Mitchell landed at Fra Mauro, conducting two moonwalks and science experiments.
summary_zh: 谢泼德与米切尔在弗拉莫罗着陆，完成两次月面行走与科学实验。

source: Wikipedia 'Shijian' 条目；Beijing Review《Chronicle Events of China's Space Industry》（1971-03-03）
summary_en: China's second satellite and first scientific experimental satellite, carrying cosmic-ray instruments; it operated for eight years and validated basic satellite technologies.
summary_zh: 中国第二颗卫星、第一颗科学试验卫星，携带宇宙线探测器，在轨工作长达八年，验证了卫星基本技术。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: Mars orbiter lost when its Centaur upper stage failed; crashed into the Atlantic Ocean.
summary_zh: 火星轨道器，因半人马座上面级故障坠入大西洋，水手计划中失败的一次。
首个进入火星轨道的人造卫星，着陆器成为首个撞击火星的人造物。
summary_en: First spacecraft to orbit Mars; its lander became the first human-made object to impact Mars.
First spacecraft to orbit another planet; mapped Mars globally and discovered Valles Marineris.
summary_zh: 首个环绕其他行星的人造卫星，绘制首张火星全球地图，发现水手谷。

source: Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: Three cosmonauts staffed Salyut 1; all died from cabin depressurization during return on 30 Jun 1971.
summary_zh: 三名航天员完成礼炮1号驻留，返回时座舱失压全部遇难。（实际失事于1971-06-30）

summary_en: First Lunar Roving Vehicle; three-day exploration of Hadley-Apennine with major sample return.
summary_zh: 首次使用月球车，三天考察哈德利-亚平宁，带回大量月岩。
首次在金星表面成功软着陆并传回数据，在炼狱环境中工作约50分钟。
summary_en: First fully successful soft landing on Venus, transmitting surface data for about 50 minutes.
Young and Duke explored the Descartes Highlands, the only highlands landing.
summary_zh: 杨与杜克考察笛卡尔高地，是唯一在月球高地着陆的任务。

summary_en: Final Moon landing; geologist Harrison Schmitt became the first scientist on the Moon.
summary_zh: 最后一次登月，施密特成为首位登月的科学家，创多项纪录。

summary_en: First probe to fly past Saturn, after a close Jupiter encounter; now heading into interstellar space.
summary_zh: 首个飞越土星的探测器，此前近距离掠过木星，如今正飞向太阳系外深空。

source: Wikipedia 'Skylab' mission table; NASA history articles
summary_en: First Skylab crew repaired the damaged station and set a 28-day duration record.
summary_zh: 天空实验室首批乘组，修复受损空间站，创28天飞行纪录。

summary_en: Second crew's 59-day stay focused on solar observation and medical experiments.
summary_zh: 第二批乘组驻留59天，开展太阳观测与医学实验。

summary_en: First probe to visit Mercury, using a Venus gravity assist; mapped Mercury over three flybys.
summary_zh: 首个飞越水星的探测器，利用金星引力助推，三次掠过水星测绘其表面。

summary_en: Final crew's 84-day mission set a then-record for human spaceflight duration.
summary_zh: 最后一批乘组驻留84天，创当时载人飞行时长纪录。

summary_en: Soviet second-generation civilian station hosted two crews over 770 days in orbit.
summary_zh: 苏联第二代民用空间站，接待两批乘组，在轨运行770天。
人类历史上首个金星轨道器，携带的着陆器首次从金星表面传回照片。
summary_en: First Venus orbiter; its lander returned the first images from the surface of another planet.

summary_zh: 金星轨道与着陆组合探测任务，着陆器成功传回金星表面全景照片。
summary_en: Venus orbiter-lander mission; the lander transmitted panoramic images from the surface.

agency_zh: 美国国家航空航天局 / 苏联航天计划
source: Wikipedia 'Apollo–Soyuz'; Wikipedia 'List of Soviet human spaceflight missions'
summary_en: First joint U.S.-Soviet crewed flight; Apollo docked with Soyuz 19, ending the Space Race.
summary_zh: 美苏首次联合载人飞行，阿波罗与联盟19号在轨对接，终结太空竞赛。（双方共记一条）

summary_en: First successful long-lived Mars landing; orbiter-lander pair returned color panoramas of Mars.
summary_zh: 首个成功登陆火星并长期工作的探测器，轨道器加着陆器组合，发回火星彩色全景。

source: Wikipedia 'Viking 2' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Second Viking mission; landed at Utopia Planitia and operated nearly four years searching for life.
summary_zh: 维京计划第二艘火星探测器，在乌托邦平原着陆，工作近4年寻找生命迹象。

name_zh: 返回式卫星零号一号星
source: Wikipedia 'Fanhui Shi Weixing' 条目；Beijing Review（1975-11-26 发射，11-29 回收）
summary_en: China's first successfully recovered returnable satellite, carrying film cameras; its capsule was recovered three days later, making China the third nation to master satellite recovery.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗成功回收的返回式卫星，搭载胶片相机，三天后返回舱在贵州六枝回收成功，中国成为第三个掌握卫星回收技术的国家。

summary_en: Venus orbiter of the Pioneer Venus project; radar-mapped Venus during 14 years in orbit.
summary_zh: 先驱者金星计划的轨道器，环绕金星14年，用雷达测绘金星表面地形。

summary_en: Released four probes into Venus's atmosphere to directly measure its composition and structure.
summary_zh: 向金星大气释放4个进入舱的探测器，直接测量金星大气的成分与结构。
首次传回金星表面彩色照片并完成土壤成分分析，工作127分钟。
summary_en: Returned the first color images from Venus's surface and analyzed soil composition.

summary_zh: 执行金星表面探测任务，搭载的麦克风记录到疑似金星表面的风声。
summary_en: Venus surface mission whose microphone recorded what may be wind sounds on Venus.
Joint US-Dutch-UK infrared telescope; first all-sky infrared survey, cataloging hundreds of thousands of sources.
summary_zh: 美荷英联合红外空间望远镜，首次完成全天红外巡天，发现数十万个红外源。
金星雷达测绘轨道器，与金星16号协同绘制北半球高分辨率地形图。
summary_en: Venus radar-mapping orbiter that mapped the northern hemisphere with Venera 16.

summary_zh: 与金星15号协同完成金星北半球雷达测绘，最后信号为协助织女星1号。
summary_en: Completed Venus northern-hemisphere radar mapping with Venera 15; last contact June 1985.

summary_zh: 在金星投放着陆器与首个地外大气气球，随后于1986年掠过哈雷彗星。
summary_en: Deployed a Venus lander and the first extraterrestrial balloon, then flew by Halley's Comet.

summary_zh: 金星着陆与大气气球探测，1986年3月9日近距离掠过哈雷彗星。
summary_en: Venus lander and balloon mission; flew by Halley's Comet on 9 March 1986.

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本首个深空探测器，哈雷舰队成员，1986年3月掠过哈雷彗星。
summary_en: Japan's first deep-space probe; flew by Halley's Comet in March 1986 as part of the Halley Armada.

summary_zh: ESA首个深空任务，首次近距离拍摄哈雷彗星彗核，后又掠过另一颗彗星。
summary_en: ESA's first deep-space mission; first close-up images of Halley's nucleus, later visited a second comet.

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本研制的哈雷彗星紫外成像探测器，掠过彗星后又长期观测太阳风。
summary_en: Japanese Halley probe that imaged the comet in ultraviolet, then studied the solar wind for years.
Challenger broke apart 73 seconds after liftoff; all seven crew members were lost.
summary_zh: 挑战者号升空73秒后解体，7名乘员全部遇难，包括教师麦考利夫。

summary_en: Mir's first expansion module carried X-ray telescopes, opening the modular station era.
summary_zh: 和平号首个扩展舱，搭载X射线望远镜，开启模块化空间站时代。
前往火卫一途中因错误指令关闭姿控系统而失联，最终未能抵达火星。
summary_en: Lost en route to Phobos after an erroneous command shut down attitude control.

summary_zh: 进入火星轨道并传回大量探测数据，在释放火卫一着陆器之前失联。
summary_en: Reached Mars orbit and returned data; contact lost just before the Phobos lander release.

source: 国家卫星气象中心 NSMC《Fengyun Program Overview》（1988-09-07）；Beijing Review《China's Milestones in Space》
summary_en: China's first polar-orbiting meteorological satellite, inaugurating the Fengyun series, which later became part of the global weather-observation network.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗极轨气象卫星，开启风云气象卫星系列，此后成为全球气象观测网的重要组成部分。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: First post-Challenger return to flight; Discovery deployed a communications satellite.
summary_zh: 挑战者号事故后首次复飞，发现号重返太空部署通信卫星。

summary_en: Venus radar mapper; pierced the clouds with synthetic aperture radar to map the surface in high resolution.
summary_zh: 金星雷达测绘轨道器，用合成孔径雷达穿透云层，绘制高分辨率金星地图。
人类首颗空间天体测量卫星，绘制了11.8万颗恒星的高精度星表。
summary_en: First space astrometry mission, producing the high-precision Hipparcos catalogue of 118,218 stars.
Measured the cosmic microwave background with unprecedented precision, confirming Big Bang predictions.
summary_zh: 精确测量宇宙微波背景辐射的卫星，为大爆炸理论提供关键证据，获诺贝尔奖。
苏联与法国等合作的X射线和伽马射线天文台，大椭圆轨道运行近十年。
summary_en: Soviet-French X-ray and gamma-ray observatory operating in high Earth orbit for a decade.

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本首个月球探测器，验证低能耗地月转移轨道，末期主动撞击月球。
summary_en: Japan's first lunar probe; demonstrated low-energy transfers and was deliberately impacted in 1993.
Discovery deployed the Hubble Space Telescope, opening a new era of space astronomy.
summary_zh: 发现号将哈勃空间望远镜送入轨道，开启空间天文新时代。

summary_en: Joint NASA-ESA probe; first to fly over the Sun's poles, studying the solar wind and heliosphere.
summary_zh: NASA与欧空局联合太阳极轨探测器，首次飞越太阳两极，观测太阳风与日球层。

name_zh: 康普顿伽玛射线天文台
source: Wikipedia 'Compton Gamma Ray Observatory' 条目
summary_en: Gamma-ray observatory that cataloged thousands of bursts and high-energy sources; deorbited in 2000.
summary_zh: 探测宇宙伽玛射线暴与高能天体的空间天文台，工作近9年后受控再入大气层。

summary_en: Mars orbiter lost three days before orbit insertion — one of NASA's costliest failures.
summary_zh: 火星轨道器，在进入火星轨道前3天失联，是NASA一次代价高昂的失败。

summary_en: Endeavour's first Hubble servicing mission restored the telescope's vision with five EVAs.
summary_zh: 奋进号首次维修哈勃望远镜，5次太空行走使其恢复清晰视力。

source: Wikipedia 'Clementine (spacecraft)' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Joint DoD-NASA lunar mapper; mapped the Moon globally and found hints of polar water ice.
summary_zh: 美国防部与NASA联合月球探测器，绘制月球全球地图，发现月极水冰迹象。
ESA与NASA合作的太阳观测站，位于日地L1点，已发现数千颗彗星。
summary_en: ESA/NASA solar observatory at Sun-Earth L1; discovered thousands of comets while studying the Sun.
source: Wikipedia 'Solar and Heliospheric Observatory' / ESA官网

summary_en: First spacecraft to orbit an asteroid; orbited Eros for a year, then soft-landed on its surface.
summary_zh: 首个环绕小行星的探测器，环绕爱神星一年后成功软着陆于其表面。

source: Wikipedia 'Mars Global Surveyor' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Mapped Mars in high-resolution topography and found evidence of recent water flows.
summary_zh: 绘制高精度火星地形图的轨道器，发现火星近代水流活动的痕迹。

summary_en: Mars lander plus the first Mars rover Sojourner; proved low-cost Mars landing techniques.
summary_zh: 火星着陆器与首辆火星车索杰纳号，验证了低成本登陆火星的技术路线。

source: 国家卫星气象中心 NSMC《Fengyun Program Overview》（1997-06-10）
summary_en: China's first geostationary meteorological satellite, establishing a combined polar-orbiting and geostationary observation system.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗静止轨道气象卫星，实现极轨与静止轨道双星观测布局，定点于东经105度上空。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: Lunar polar orbiter that mapped water ice and elements; ended with a planned lunar impact.
summary_zh: 月球极轨探测器，探测月球水冰与元素分布，最终受控撞击月面结束任务。

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本首个火星探测器，燃料与故障致未能入轨，成为环绕太阳的人造天体。
summary_en: Japan's first Mars probe; fuel and system failures left it in heliocentric orbit instead of Mars orbit.
Technology demonstrator; first deep-space ion propulsion, flew by an asteroid and a comet.
summary_zh: 深空技术验证探测器，首次在深空使用离子推进，飞越小行星与彗星。

summary_en: At 77, John Glenn returned to space as the oldest astronaut, aiding aging research.
summary_zh: 77岁的格伦重返太空，成为当时最年长的航天员，进行老年医学研究。

source: NASA 'International Space Station Assembly Elements'; Wikipedia 'Assembly of the ISS'
summary_en: ISS's first U.S. segment, delivered by Endeavour, linking the American and Russian sections.
summary_zh: 国际空间站首个美国舱段，由奋进号送入轨道，连接美俄舱段。

summary_en: Burned up in the Martian atmosphere due to a metric/imperial unit mix-up — a famous cautionary tale.
summary_zh: 因英制与公制单位混用而在火星大气中烧毁，成为著名的工程教训。

summary_en: Mars polar lander lost during descent to the south pole; the cause remains unknown.
summary_zh: 火星南极着陆器，在下降过程中失联，失联原因至今成谜。

summary_en: First comet sample-return mission; collected dust from Comet Wild 2 and returned it to Earth.
summary_zh: 首个彗星采样返回任务，采集维尔特2号彗星尘埃并送回地球分析。

source: Wikipedia 'Shijian' 条目（1999-05-10，与风云一号C同箭发射）
summary_en: China's first small-satellite technology test platform, validating the CAST968 bus that underpinned later Chinese small satellites.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗小卫星技术试验平台，验证 CAST968 小卫星公用平台，为后续小卫星研制奠定基础。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 1' 条目（1999-11-19 22:30 UTC，北京时间 11-20 06:30）；新华社1999-11-21报道
summary_en: First uncrewed test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft and Long March 2F; the capsule landed after 14 orbits, opening China's human spaceflight program.
summary_zh: 神舟飞船与长征二号F首次无人试验飞行，绕地14圈后返回舱成功着陆，拉开中国载人航天工程序幕。
ESA的大型X射线天文台，研究黑洞、星系团与宇宙中的高能辐射。
summary_en: ESA X-ray observatory studying black holes, galaxy clusters and high-energy cosmic sources.
Russian service module providing life support and attitude control, still in service.
summary_zh: 空间站俄方核心服务舱，提供生命保障与姿态控制，至今在役。
四颗卫星编队三维研究地球磁层，2024年首颗卫星再入大气层任务结束。
summary_en: Four-spacecraft formation studying Earth's magnetosphere in 3D; ended with reentries from 2024.

source: Wikipedia 'List of BeiDou satellites'（2000-10-30 16:02 UTC，北京时间 10-31）；Global Times 北斗发展史（2000-10-31）
summary_en: First experimental satellite of the BeiDou navigation system; with its twin it formed China's first-generation regional navigation system, ending total reliance on GPS.
summary_zh: 北斗导航系统第一颗试验星，2000年底双星组网建成中国第一代区域卫星导航系统，摆脱对GPS的完全依赖。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: First Soyuz to reach the ISS, delivering the first long-duration Expedition 1 crew.
summary_zh: 首个抵达国际空间站的联盟飞船，送去第一批长期驻留乘组。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2001-01-09 17:00 UTC，北京时间 01-10）
summary_en: Second uncrewed Shenzhou test flight, first to carry animals and space-science payloads; it spent nearly seven days in orbit.
summary_zh: 神舟第二次无人试验飞行，首次搭载动物与空间科学载荷，在轨近七天，轨道舱留轨继续工作近半年。

summary_en: U.S. Destiny laboratory, the station's main research platform, delivered by Atlantis.
summary_zh: 美国命运号实验舱，空间站主要科研平台，2001年由亚特兰蒂斯号送达。

summary_en: Mars orbiter that discovered subsurface water ice; still relaying data after two decades.
summary_zh: 发现火星地下水冰的火星轨道器，工作20余年，仍在为火星任务中继数据。

name_zh: 威尔金森微波各向异性探测器
source: Wikipedia 'Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe' 条目
summary_en: Measured the universe's age at 13.8 billion years and its composition from Sun-Earth L2.
summary_zh: 精确测定宇宙年龄138亿年与宇宙组成的微波背景探测器，驻守日地L2点。

summary_en: Solar wind sample-return mission at Sun-Earth L1; the capsule crash-landed but samples survived.
summary_zh: 在日地L1点收集太阳风粒子的采样任务，返回舱硬着陆但多数样本幸存。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2002-03-25 14:15 UTC，北京时间 22:15）
summary_en: Third uncrewed test flight carrying a simulated human metabolic system, fully validating life-support and emergency systems for crewed flight.
summary_zh: 第三次无人试验飞行，搭载人体代谢模拟装置，全面验证了载人飞行环境控制与应急救生系统。

summary_en: Comet nucleus probe destroyed when its engine exploded during orbit insertion.
summary_zh: 彗星核探测器，在点火进入转移轨道时发动机爆炸解体，任务失败。
ESA伽马射线天文台，观测黑洞、伽马暴与超新星，2025年初退役。
summary_en: ESA gamma-ray observatory studying black holes and gamma-ray bursts; retired in February 2025.

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2002-12-29 16:40 UTC，北京时间 12-30）
summary_en: Final uncrewed test before the first crewed flight, in full crewed configuration; its success cleared the way for Shenzhou 5.
summary_zh: 载人首飞前最后一次无人试验，飞船状态与载人构型完全一致，成功验证后直接转入神舟五号载人飞行。

summary_en: Columbia disintegrated during reentry on 1 Feb 2003, killing all seven crew.
summary_zh: 哥伦比亚号再入大气层时解体，7名乘员遇难，隔热瓦损伤所致。（失事于2003-02-01）

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 人类首次小行星采样返回任务，历经多次故障从“糸川”带回微粒。
summary_en: First asteroid sample return; overcame major failures to bring grains back from Itokawa.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to minor planets'

summary_zh: ESA首个火星探测任务，发现火星地下水冰与甲烷迹象，至今仍在工作。
summary_en: ESA's first Mars mission; found evidence of subsurface water ice and methane traces.
Mars rover designed for 90 days that operated 15 years, driving a record 45 km.
summary_zh: 设计工作90天却运行15年的火星车，行驶45公里，创下地外行驶纪录。

summary_en: Infrared space telescope that observed early galaxies and exoplanets for 16 years.
summary_zh: 观测早期星系与系外行星的红外空间望远镜，在日心轨道工作16年。
ESA首个月球探测器，验证太阳电推进技术，任务末期撞击月球。
summary_en: ESA's first lunar mission, demonstrating solar electric propulsion; impacted the Moon in 2006.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 人类首次环绕彗星并释放着陆器菲莱，最终以撞击彗星67P结束使命。
summary_en: First mission to orbit a comet and land a probe on it; ended with impact on 67P in 2016.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to minor planets'

summary_en: First spacecraft to orbit Mercury; mapped it globally and found polar water ice.
summary_zh: 首个环绕水星的探测器，绘制水星全球地图，发现水星极区存在水冰。

source: Wikipedia 'Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory' 条目
summary_en: Gamma-ray burst observatory that rapidly pinpoints cosmic bursts; still operating.
summary_zh: 快速定位宇宙伽玛射线暴的空间天文台，至今仍在工作，轨道预计2026年底衰减。

summary_en: Fired a copper impactor into Comet Tempel 1 to study its interior composition.
summary_zh: 向坦普尔1号彗星发射铜弹撞击器，撞击扬起的物质揭示了彗星内部成分。

summary_en: Carries the most powerful Mars camera HiRISE and relays data for surface missions.
summary_zh: 搭载最强火星相机HiRISE的轨道器，兼任火星表面任务的数据中继站。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2005-10-12 01:00 UTC，北京时间 09:00）
summary_en: China's second crewed flight; two taikonauts entered the orbital module for the first time to conduct space-science experiments over nearly five days.
summary_zh: 中国第二次载人飞行，费俊龙、聂海胜双人乘组首次进入轨道舱开展空间科学实验，在轨近五天。
ESA的金星轨道器，研究金星大气超级旋转与疑似火山活动迹象。
summary_en: ESA Venus orbiter studying the super-rotating atmosphere and possible volcanic activity.

source: Wikipedia 'List of BeiDou satellites'（2007-04-13 20:11 UTC，北京时间 04-14）；Beijing Review（2007-04-14）
summary_en: First medium-Earth-orbit test satellite of second-generation BeiDou, securing navigation frequencies and validating new payloads as the system expanded toward global coverage.
summary_zh: 北斗二代首颗中圆轨道试验星，抢占导航频率资源并验证新一代导航载荷，标志北斗从区域走向全球。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: Mars polar lander that dug into arctic soil and confirmed subsurface water ice.
summary_zh: 在火星北极挖掘土壤的着陆器，证实火星地下存在水冰，工作5个月。

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本大型月球轨道器，精密测绘月球地形与重力场，拍下“地出”高清影像。
summary_en: Major Japanese lunar orbiter mapping topography and gravity; captured iconic 'Earthrise' HD footage.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'
Wikipedia 'Dawn (spacecraft)' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: First probe to orbit two bodies — Vesta then Ceres — using ion propulsion.
summary_zh: 首个环绕两个天体的探测器，依靠离子推进先后环绕灶神星与谷神星。

source: Wikipedia 'Tianlian' 条目（2008-04-25 15:35 UTC，北京时间 23:35）
summary_en: China's first geostationary data-relay satellite, providing space-based tracking and communications relay for Shenzhou 7 and later crewed missions.
summary_zh: 中国第一颗地球同步轨道数据中继卫星，被称为“太空天路”，为神舟七号及后续载人任务提供天基测控中继。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

source: 国家卫星气象中心 NSMC《Fengyun Program Overview》（2008-05-27）；GlobalSecurity FY-3
summary_en: First satellite of China's second-generation polar-orbiting meteorological series, carrying 11 remote-sensing instruments with internationally competitive capability.
summary_zh: 中国第二代极轨气象卫星首星，搭载11台遥感仪器、99个探测通道，探测能力达到国际先进水平。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

name_zh: 费米伽玛射线空间望远镜
source: Wikipedia 'Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope' 条目
summary_en: Gamma-ray telescope surveying pulsars, black holes, and dark matter signals.
summary_zh: 巡天观测脉冲星、黑洞与暗物质信号的伽玛射线望远镜，国际合作项目。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2008-09-25 13:10 UTC，北京时间 21:10）
summary_en: Zhai Zhigang performed China's first spacewalk with crewmates Liu Boming and Jing Haipeng; the mission first used the Tianlian-1 relay satellite for space-based tracking.
summary_zh: 翟志刚完成中国首次太空行走，刘伯明、景海鹏配合，任务中首次使用天链一号中继卫星实现天基测控。

summary_en: Maps the boundary between the solar system and interstellar space from Earth orbit.
summary_zh: 从地球轨道绘制太阳系与星际空间交界的首张全天图，至今仍在工作。
印度的首个月球探测任务，发现了月球表面存在水分子的关键证据。
summary_en: India's first lunar mission; found key evidence of water molecules on the Moon.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 曾是口径最大的空间远红外望远镜，致力于研究恒星与星系的诞生过程。
summary_en: Largest far-infrared space telescope of its time, studying star and galaxy formation.

summary_zh: 精确测量宇宙微波背景辐射，给出迄今最精确的宇宙年龄与物质组分。
summary_en: Mapped the cosmic microwave background with unprecedented precision, pinning down the universe's age.

name_zh: 月球坑观测与传感卫星
summary_en: Crashed a Centaur stage into the lunar south pole, confirming water ice in the soil.
summary_zh: 用半人马座上面级撞击月球南极，扬起的尘埃证实月壤中含有水冰。

summary_en: Lunar mapper producing high-resolution maps to pick Artemis landing sites.
summary_zh: 绘制高精度月球地图的轨道器，为阿耳忒弥斯登月计划挑选着陆点。

source: Wikipedia 'Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Infrared survey telescope later repurposed as NEOWISE to hunt near-Earth asteroids.
summary_zh: 红外巡天望远镜，后转为NEOWISE搜寻近地小行星，发现数千颗小行星与彗星。

summary_en: Observes the Sun around the clock, streaming 1.5 TB of solar imagery daily.
summary_zh: 24小时不间断观测太阳的空间天文台，每天传回1.5TB太阳活动图像数据。

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本金星气象卫星，入轨失败后漂流5年二次入轨成功，2025年正式退役。
summary_en: Venus climate orbiter rescued into orbit five years after a failed insertion; retired in 2025.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to Venus' / JAXA（2025年终止运营报道）

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 世界首个成功展开的太阳帆飞船，与晓号同箭发射并成功掠过金星。
summary_en: World's first successful solar-sail spacecraft; flew past Venus after launching with Akatsuki.

source: Wikipedia 'Chang'e 2' 条目（2010-10-01 10:59 UTC，北京时间 18:59；2014年失联）
summary_en: Repurposed Chang'e 1 backup that mapped the Moon in high resolution, then flew on to Sun-Earth L2 and a flyby of asteroid 4179 Toutatis — China's first asteroid encounter.
summary_zh: 嫦娥一号备份星改作先导任务，环月拍摄高分辨率影像后拓展至日地L2点并飞掠小行星4179号，中国首探小行星。
status_note_zh: 任务已结束；本目录尚未核实结束日期。
status_note_en: Mission ended; the end date has not been verified in this catalog.

summary_en: Atlantis flew the final Space Shuttle mission, closing the 30-year program.
summary_zh: 亚特兰蒂斯号执行航天飞机最后一次飞行，30年计划落幕。
10米口径空间射电望远镜，与地面站组成超长基线干涉阵，2019年失联退役。
summary_en: 10-m space radio telescope forming an interferometer with ground stations; lost in 2019.

name_zh: 重力恢复与内部实验室
source: Wikipedia 'GRAIL' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Twin probes flying in formation mapped the Moon's gravity field in high resolution.
summary_zh: 双子探测器编队飞行，绘制高精度月球重力场图，揭示月壳内部结构。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Tiangong-1' 条目（2011-09-29 13:16 UTC，北京时间 21:16；2018-04-02 再入）
summary_en: China's first space-lab target vehicle; it docked with Shenzhou 8, 9 and 10 to validate rendezvous-and-docking technology, reentering in 2018.
summary_zh: 中国首个目标飞行器，先后与神舟八号、九号、十号交会对接，验证空间交会对接技术，2018年再入大气层。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2011-10-31 21:58 UTC，北京时间 11-01）
summary_en: Uncrewed rendezvous-and-docking test spacecraft that achieved China's first orbital docking with Tiangong-1.
summary_zh: 无人交会对接试验飞船，与天宫一号完成中国首次空间交会对接，突破载人航天基本技术。
俄罗斯火卫一采样返回任务，变轨失败滞留地球轨道，最终于2012年坠毁。
summary_en: Russian Phobos sample-return attempt stranded in Earth orbit; reentered in January 2012.
Focusing hard X-ray telescope observing black holes and supernova remnants.
summary_zh: 聚焦高能X射线的空间望远镜，观测黑洞、超新星遗迹等高能天体。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2012-06-16 10:37 UTC，北京时间 18:37）
summary_en: First crewed docking mission; Jing Haipeng, Liu Wang and Liu Yang (China's first woman in space) boarded Tiangong-1 and completed manual docking tests.
summary_zh: 首次载人交会对接，景海鹏、刘旺、刘洋（中国首位女航天员）进驻天宫一号，完成手动交会对接试验。

source: Wikipedia 'Gaofen 1' 条目（2013-04-26 04:13 UTC，北京时间 12:13）；新华社2013-04-26报道
summary_en: First satellite of China's high-resolution Earth-observation system, with 2 m panchromatic imaging for disaster relief, land surveys and precision agriculture.
summary_zh: 高分辨率对地观测系统首星，2米全色/8米多光谱成像，用于防灾减灾、国土资源调查与精准农业。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2013-06-11 09:38 UTC，北京时间 17:38）
summary_en: Second visit to Tiangong-1; Nie Haisheng, Zhang Xiaoguang and Wang Yaping delivered China's first live space lecture, proving the crew-transport system mature.
summary_zh: 第二次访问天宫一号，聂海胜、张晓光、王亚平在轨开展首次太空授课，验证天地往返运输系统成熟度。

name_zh: 月球大气与尘埃环境探测器
summary_en: Studied the Moon's thin exosphere and dust; also demonstrated lunar laser communications.
summary_zh: 研究月球稀薄大气与尘埃的轨道器，还验证了月球激光通信技术。
印度的首次火星探测任务即一次成功入轨，成为亚洲首个火星轨道器。
summary_en: India's first Mars mission succeeded on its first attempt; Asia's first Mars orbiter.

name_zh: 火星大气与挥发物演化探测器
source: Wikipedia 'MAVEN' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Studied how the solar wind stripped Mars's atmosphere; lost in late 2025, declared dead 2026.
summary_zh: 研究太阳风如何剥离火星大气的轨道器，2025年底失联，2026年宣告任务终结。
绘制近20亿颗恒星三维星图，2025年3月关机，数据将沿用数十年。
summary_en: Built a 3D map of nearly two billion stars; switched off in March 2025.

source: 中文 Wikipedia '探月工程三期再入返回飞行试验器' 条目（北京时间 2014-10-24 02:00:04 发射，11-01 返回器着陆）；CAS 英文报道
summary_en: Chang'e 5 pathfinder that validated high-speed lunar reentry; its 'Xiaofei' capsule looped the Moon and landed, while the service module extended to Earth-Moon L2 and lunar orbit.
summary_zh: 嫦娥五号探路星，验证月地高速再入返回技术，“小飞”返回器绕月一周后成功着陆，服务舱拓展至地月L2与环月轨道。

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 从小行星“龙宫”采样返回，现执行扩展任务，2031年抵达新目标。
summary_en: Returned samples from asteroid Ryugu; now on an extended mission to another asteroid.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to minor planets'

summary_zh: 印度的首个空间天文台，能够用多个波段同时观测宇宙中的各类天体。
summary_en: India's first space observatory, observing the cosmos in multiple wavelengths simultaneously.

summary_zh: 验证空间引力波探测关键技术，为2030年代LISA任务探路。
summary_en: Demonstrated key technologies for space-based gravitational-wave detection ahead of LISA.

source: Wikipedia 'Dark Matter Particle Explorer' 条目（2015-12-17 00:12 UTC，北京时间 08:12）；新华社2015-12-17报道
summary_en: Dark Matter Particle Explorer, China's first space observatory, hunting dark-matter annihilation signals in high-energy electrons and gamma rays; nicknamed after the Monkey King.
summary_zh: 暗物质粒子探测卫星，中国首颗空间天文卫星，通过高能电子与伽马射线寻找暗物质湮灭证据，以《西游记》悟空命名。
欧俄合作探测火星大气甲烷，着陆器斯基亚帕雷利坠毁，轨道器正常工作。
summary_en: Hunts for Martian methane; its Schiaparelli lander crashed but the orbiter operates normally.

source: CAS newsletter（2016-04-06 发射，04-18 返回舱着陆）；jagranjosh 2016-04-06 报道
summary_en: China's first microgravity science satellite, recoverable, carrying 19 fluid-physics, combustion and space-life experiments; its capsule returned after 12 days.
summary_zh: 中国首颗微重力科学实验卫星，可返回式，搭载19项流体物理、燃烧与空间生命科学实验，返回舱12天后回收。

source: CAS/SASAC 报道（2016-08-16 01:40 北京时间酒泉发射）；人民网2016-08-16
summary_en: World's first quantum-science satellite, achieving thousand-kilometer satellite-to-ground quantum key distribution and quantum teleportation, laying the groundwork for a global quantum network.
summary_zh: 世界首颗量子科学实验卫星，实现千公里级星地量子密钥分发与量子隐形传态，奠定全球量子通信网基础。

summary_en: First US asteroid sample-return; delivered Bennu samples, now en route to Apophis as OSIRIS-APEX.
summary_zh: 首个美国小行星采样返回任务，从贝努带回样本，现改名前往阿波菲斯。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Tiangong-2' 条目（2016-09-15 14:04 UTC，北京时间 22:04；2019-07-19 离轨）
summary_en: China's first true space laboratory; the Shenzhou 11 crew stayed 30 days and Tianzhou 1 performed three propellant refuellings; deorbited in a controlled reentry in 2019.
summary_zh: 中国首个真正意义的空间实验室，神舟十一号乘组驻留30天，天舟一号完成三次在轨推进剂补加，2019年受控离轨。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 11' 条目（2016-10-16 23:30 UTC，北京时间 10-17 07:30）
summary_en: Jing Haipeng and Chen Dong boarded Tiangong-2 for a 33-day mission, then China's longest crewed flight, validating medium-duration station stays.
summary_zh: 景海鹏、陈冬进驻天宫二号，33天任务创当时中国载人飞行时长纪录，验证空间站中期驻留能力。

source: 国家卫星气象中心 NSMC《Fengyun Program Overview》（2016-12-11）
summary_en: First satellite of China's second-generation geostationary weather series, with 20× the observation efficiency of its predecessor and world-leading lightning imaging.
summary_zh: 中国第二代静止轨道气象卫星首星，观测效率比上一代提升20倍，闪电成像与干涉式大气探测国际领先。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Tianzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2017-04-20 11:41 UTC，北京时间 19:41；2017-09-22 离轨）
summary_en: China's first cargo spacecraft; it docked three times with Tiangong-2 and completed orbital propellant refuelling, validating the station resupply system.
summary_zh: 中国首艘货运飞船，与天宫二号三次交会对接并完成在轨推进剂补加，验证空间站货物运输与补给体系。

source: Chinese Academy of Sciences: China Launches its First Space-Based X-ray Telescope（2017-06-15 11:00 北京时间 / 03:00 UTC）
summary_en: Hard X-ray Modulation Telescope, China's first X-ray astronomy satellite, observing black holes, neutron stars and gamma-ray bursts across 1–250 keV.
summary_zh: 硬X射线调制望远镜，中国首颗X射线天文卫星，观测黑洞、中子星与伽马暴，1-250keV能段巡天能力突出。

name_zh: 凌日系外行星巡天卫星
source: Wikipedia 'Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite' 条目
summary_en: Kepler's successor surveying the whole sky for exoplanets; found thousands of candidates.
summary_zh: 开普勒的继任者，全天搜寻系外行星，已发现数千颗候选行星。

source: Wikipedia 'InSight' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Mars lander whose seismometer detected 1,300+ marsquakes, revealing Mars's interior.
summary_zh: 携带地震仪的火星着陆器，探测到1300多次火星震，揭示火星内部结构。

source: Wikipedia 'Queqiao-1' 条目（2018-05-20 21:28 UTC，北京时间 05-21 05:28）
summary_en: World's first communications relay satellite at the Earth-Moon L2 point, bridging Earth and the Chang'e 4 far-side lander while doing low-frequency radio astronomy.
summary_zh: 世界首颗地月L2点中继通信卫星，为嫦娥四号月背着陆搭建“鹊桥”，兼做低频射电天文观测，取名自牛郎织女传说。

summary_en: Closest human-made object to the Sun; flew through the corona to study the solar wind's origin.
summary_zh: 人类最接近太阳的探测器，飞入日冕研究太阳风起源，创最快人造物纪录。

summary_en: Booster separation failure triggered the launch escape system; both crew landed safely.
summary_zh: 发射后助推器分离故障，逃逸系统启动，两名乘员弹道返回平安落地。

agency_zh: 欧洲空间局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 欧日合作水星探测器，历经多次借力飞行，2026年底进入水星轨道。
summary_en: ESA-JAXA Mercury mission cruising via gravity assists; Mercury orbit insertion due late 2026.
Humanity's first soft landing on the Moon's far side; the lander and Yutu-2 rover explore Von Kármán crater, relaying data via the Queqiao satellite.
summary_zh: 人类首次月球背面软着陆，着陆器与玉兔二号巡视器在冯·卡门撞击坑开展巡视探测，通过鹊桥中继星传回数据。
以色列首个月球探测任务，民间筹资的低成本登月尝试，着陆前坠毁。
summary_en: Israel's first lunar mission, a privately funded low-cost attempt that crashed before landing.
source: Wikipedia 'Beresheet' / 'List of missions to the Moon'

summary_zh: 俄德合作X射线巡天望远镜，位于日地L2点，绘制全天X射线源图。
summary_en: Russian-German X-ray survey telescope at Sun-Earth L2 mapping the X-ray sky.

summary_zh: 虽然着陆器坠毁，但轨道器持续工作，绘制高精度的月球地形与矿物图。
summary_en: Lander crashed but the orbiter keeps working, mapping the Moon's terrain and minerals.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'
CAS 英文报道（2019-08-31 发射，在轨试验完成）；GlobalSecurity
summary_en: China's first space-based gravitational-wave technology test satellite, validating laser interferometry and ultra-stable platform technologies.
summary_zh: 中国首颗空间引力波探测技术实验卫星，验证激光干涉、超稳超静平台等关键技术，迈出天基引力波探测第一步。

summary_en: China's first sub-meter optical stereo-mapping satellite, enabling 1:10,000-scale mapping for natural-resource surveys and national base mapping.
summary_zh: 中国首颗亚米级光学立体测绘卫星，双线阵立体相机实现1:10000比例尺测图，服务自然资源调查与基础测绘。
ESA的系外行星凌星观测卫星，精确测量系外行星的半径与密度。
summary_en: ESA exoplanet mission precisely measuring the radii of planets around other stars.

summary_zh: 欧美合作的近距离太阳探测器，将来首次直接拍摄太阳的两极地区。
summary_en: ESA/NASA mission flying close to the Sun; will deliver the first images of the solar poles.

source: 国务院国资委/新华社（北京时间 2020-06-23 09:43 西昌发射）；Wikipedia 'List of BeiDou satellites'
summary_en: The 30th BeiDou-3 networking satellite (55th of the family), completing the global constellation half a year early and giving China an independent global navigation system.
summary_zh: 北斗三号第30颗组网卫星（第55颗北斗卫星），提前半年完成全球组网，中国建成独立自主的全球导航系统。
阿联酋首个火星探测任务，研究火星大气与气候的日变化和季节变化。
summary_en: The UAE's first Mars mission, studying the Martian atmosphere and its daily and seasonal cycles.
Mars rover collecting and caching samples in Jezero Crater for future return to Earth.
summary_zh: 在杰泽罗陨石坑采集并封存火星样本的火星车，等待未来任务取回地球。

source: NSSC/CAS 英文报道（北京时间 2020-12-10 04:14 西昌发射）；CGTN 2020-12-10
summary_en: Gravitational-wave high-energy Electromagnetic Counterpart All-sky Monitor: a twin-satellite formation watching the whole sky for gamma-ray bursts and magnetar flares.
summary_zh: 引力波暴高能电磁对应体全天监测器，双星编队全天监测伽马暴与磁星爆发，捕捉引力波事件的电磁对应体。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2021-06-17 01:22 UTC，北京时间 09:22）
summary_en: First crewed flight of the space-station era; Nie Haisheng, Liu Boming and Tang Hongbo lived in the Tianhe core module for three months and did two spacewalks.
summary_zh: 空间站阶段首次载人飞行，聂海胜、刘伯明、汤洪波进驻天和核心舱三个月，完成两次出舱活动。

source: Wikipedia 'Assembly of the International Space Station'
summary_en: Russian Nauka multipurpose lab, arriving 14 years late to expand station research capacity.
summary_zh: 俄方科学号多功能实验舱，迟到14年后终抵空间站，扩建科研能力。

source: Wikipedia 'Chinese H-alpha Solar Explorer' 条目（2021-10-14 10:51 UTC，北京时间 18:51）
summary_en: China's first solar observatory, imaging the solar chromosphere in the H-alpha band; named after Xihe, the sun goddess of Chinese mythology.
summary_zh: 中国首颗太阳探测科学技术试验卫星，以Hα波段对太阳色球成像，取名自神话中的太阳神羲和。

summary_en: On a 12-year journey to fly by eight asteroids, including Jupiter's Trojans.
summary_zh: 12年旅程中将飞越8颗小行星的探测器，包括木星特洛伊小行星群。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 13' 条目（2021-10-15 16:23 UTC，北京时间 10-16 00:23）
summary_en: Zhai Zhigang, Wang Yaping and Ye Guangfu set a six-month duration record; Wang became the first Chinese woman to spacewalk and gave a second space lecture.
summary_zh: 翟志刚、王亚平、叶光富驻留半年创纪录，王亚平成为中国首位出舱女航天员，完成第二次太空授课。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2022-06-05 02:44 UTC，北京时间 10:44）
summary_en: The station-construction bridge mission; Chen Dong, Liu Yang and Cai Xuzhe received the Wentian and Mengtian modules, completing the T-shaped station.
summary_zh: 空间站建造阶段承上启下之役，陈冬、刘洋、蔡旭哲迎接问天、梦天两舱，完成空间站T字基本构型组装。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Laboratory Cabin Module' / 'Tiangong space station' 条目（2022-07-24 06:22 UTC，北京时间 14:22）
summary_en: The station's first lab module, focused on life sciences, with an EVA airlock and robotic arm; it relocated to form the T-shaped station with Tianhe and Mengtian.
summary_zh: 空间站首个实验舱，以生命生态科学为主，带出舱气闸舱与小机械臂，转位后与天和、梦天形成T字构型。
韩国发射的第一个月球轨道器，将为韩国未来的载人登月任务探路。
summary_en: South Korea's first lunar orbiter, paving the way for future Korean Moon landings.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'
Wikipedia 'Advanced Space-based Solar Observatory' 条目（北京时间 2022-10-09 07:43:55 发射）；新华社2022-10-09
summary_en: Advanced Space-based Solar Observatory studying the solar magnetic field, flares and coronal mass ejections to support space-weather forecasting; named after Kuafu who chased the sun.
summary_zh: 先进天基太阳天文台，综合观测太阳磁场、耀斑与日冕物质抛射，为空间天气预报提供数据，取名自夸父逐日。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Laboratory Cabin Module' / 'Tiangong space station' 条目（2022-10-31 07:37 UTC，北京时间 15:37）
summary_en: The station's second lab module, focused on microgravity science with a cargo airlock; its relocation completed the T-shaped Tiangong station.
summary_zh: 空间站第二个实验舱，侧重微重力科学，带货物气闸舱，转位完成后天宫空间站三舱T字构型全面建成。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 15' 条目（2022-11-29 15:08 UTC，北京时间 23:08；2023-06-04 着陆）
summary_en: Final mission of the station-construction phase; Fei Junlong, Deng Qingming and Zhang Lu completed the first on-orbit crew handover, starting permanent occupancy.
summary_zh: 空间站建造阶段收官之战，费俊龙、邓清明、张陆与神十四乘组首次在轨轮换，实现空间站长期有人驻留。
ESA首个木星系任务，2031年抵达，研究冰卫星地下海洋的宜居性。
summary_en: ESA's first Jupiter mission; arrives 2031 to study the subsurface oceans of the icy moons.

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 16' 条目（2023-05-30 01:31 UTC，北京时间 09:31）
summary_en: Jing Haipeng, Zhu Yangzhu and Gui Haichao (China's first civilian payload specialist) flew the first crewed mission of the station's application phase.
summary_zh: 景海鹏、朱杨柱、桂海潮（中国首位载荷专家/平民航天员）进驻，完成空间站应用与发展阶段首次载人飞行。
ESA暗宇宙巡天望远镜，在日地L2点绘制暗物质与暗能量三维图。
summary_en: ESA dark-universe survey telescope at Sun-Earth L2 mapping dark matter and dark energy.

summary_zh: 人类首次在月球南极附近软着陆，印度成为第四个实现登月的国家。
summary_en: First soft landing near the lunar south pole; India became the fourth nation to land on the Moon.
source: Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon' / ISRO（The Hindu报道）

summary_zh: 俄罗斯47年来首次月球任务，变轨发动机工作异常坠毁于月球表面。
summary_en: Russia's first lunar mission in 47 years; crashed after an anomalous orbit maneuver.

summary_zh: 印度的首个太阳探测器，进驻日地L1点持续观测太阳的各种活动。
summary_en: India's first solar mission, continuously observing the Sun from Sun-Earth L1.

agency_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构
summary_zh: 日本首次月球软着陆，实现世界首次百米级精准着陆，熬过三个月夜。
summary_en: Japan's first lunar soft landing with pinpoint accuracy; survived three lunar nights.
Bound for the metal-rich asteroid Psyche, a possible exposed planetary core; arrives 2029.
summary_zh: 前往金属小行星灵神星的探测器，探索行星内核奥秘，2029年抵达。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'China Manned Space Program' 条目（2023-10-26 03:14 UTC，北京时间 11:14）
summary_en: Tang Hongbo, Tang Shengjie and Jiang Xinlin spent six months aboard, performing the first extravehicular solar-array repair and 80+ science experiments.
summary_zh: 汤洪波、唐胜杰、江新林在轨半年，完成首次舱外太阳翼维修，在轨开展80余项空间科学实验。

source: Wikipedia 'Einstein Probe' 条目（2024-01-09 07:03 UTC，北京时间 15:03）；ESA factsheet
summary_en: Time-domain high-energy astrophysics satellite using lobster-eye wide-field X-ray optics to catch transients like tidal-disruption events and gamma-ray bursts; a CAS-ESA collaboration.
summary_zh: 时域高能天体物理卫星，以“龙虾眼”宽视场X射线望远镜巡天，捕捉黑洞潮汐撕裂与伽马暴等暂现源，与欧空局合作。

source: Wikipedia 'Queqiao-2' 条目（2024-03-20 00:31 UTC，北京时间 08:31）；CNSA/新华社2024-03-20
summary_en: Relay satellite for Chang'e 6 and phase-4 lunar missions, in a lunar frozen elliptical orbit, serving Chang'e 7/8 and the International Lunar Research Station.
summary_zh: 嫦娥六号及探月四期总中继星，运行于环月大椭圆冻结轨道，服务嫦娥七号、八号与国际月球科研站，搭载天都试验星。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)' 条目（2024-04-25 12:59 UTC，北京时间 20:59）
summary_en: Ye Guangfu, Li Cong and Li Guangsu set a 192-day single-mission record, installing debris shielding and running the 'space fish' aquaculture experiment.
summary_zh: 叶光富、李聪、李广苏驻留192天创单次任务时长纪录，完成空间站碎片防护加固与“太空养鱼”实验。

agency_zh: 中国国家航天局、法国国家空间研究中心
name_zh: 天基多波段空间变源监视器
source: Wikipedia 'Space Variable Objects Monitor' 条目（2024-06-22 07:00 UTC，北京时间 15:00）；新华社2024-06-22
summary_en: Sino-French gamma-ray-burst observatory with four instruments capturing the universe's most violent explosions; it has already detected 100+ GRBs.
summary_zh: 中法联合研制的伽马暴探测卫星，四台载荷多波段捕捉宇宙最剧烈爆发现象，已发现百余个伽马暴。

source: Wikipedia 'Europa Clipper' 条目；NASA Science 任务页
summary_en: Bound for Jupiter to make 49 flybys of Europa, probing its subsurface ocean's habitability.
summary_zh: 前往木星系统的探测器，将49次飞越欧罗巴，探测其冰下海洋是否宜居。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 19' 条目；新华社（北京时间 2024-10-30 04:27 发射）
summary_en: Cai Xuzhe, Song Lingdong and Wang Haoze (China's third woman in space and first female flight engineer) spent six months installing debris-protection hardware.
summary_zh: 蔡旭哲、宋令东、王浩泽（中国第三位女航天员、首位女飞行工程师）驻留半年，完成空间碎片防护装置安装。

source: Wikipedia 'Polarimeter to Unify the Corona and Heliosphere' 条目
summary_en: Four-microsatellite constellation imaging how the corona becomes the solar wind in 3D.
summary_zh: 由4颗微卫星组成的太阳观测星座，立体观测日冕如何演变为太阳风。

summary_en: Near-infrared all-sky spectral survey mapping the cosmos in 3D to probe life's ingredients.
summary_zh: 近红外全天光谱巡天望远镜，绘制宇宙3D图谱，探寻生命起源的关键物质。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 20' 条目（2025-04-24 09:17 UTC，北京时间 17:17 发射；2026-01-19 飞船无人返回）
summary_en: Chen Dong's crew returned early aboard Shenzhou 21 after suspected debris cracked their capsule's window; the damaged Shenzhou 20 later returned uncrewed.
summary_zh: 陈冬、陈中瑞、王杰乘组因飞船舷窗疑似遭空间碎片撞击，乘组改乘神舟二十一号提前返回，飞船后无人返回。

source: Wikipedia 'Tianwen-2' 条目（2025-05-28 17:31 UTC，北京时间 05-29 01:31 发射）；SpaceNews 2025-05-28
summary_en: China's first asteroid sample-return mission; it reached near-Earth asteroid 469219 Kamo'oalewa in 2026 and will send samples to Earth in 2027 before heading to main-belt comet 311P.
summary_zh: 中国首次小行星采样返回任务，2026年抵达近地小行星469219号取样，2027年送回地球后将继续飞往主带彗星311P。

name_zh: 星际测绘与加速探测器
source: Wikipedia 'Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe' 条目；NASA 任务页
summary_en: Stationed at Sun-Earth L1 to map the solar wind's boundary with interstellar space.
summary_zh: 进驻日地L1点的探测器，绘制太阳风与星际介质交界图，监测空间天气。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 21' 条目（2025-10-31 15:44 UTC，北京时间 23:44 发射）；新华社2025-11-01
summary_en: Zhang Lu's crew achieved the first 3.5-hour fast rendezvous and carried four mice for China's first in-orbit mammalian life-science experiment.
summary_zh: 张陆、武飞、张洪章乘组首次实现3.5小时快速交会对接，并搭载四只小鼠开展中国首次哺乳动物在轨实验。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou 22' 条目（2025-11-25 发射，无人）；SpaceNews 2025-11-25
summary_en: China's first emergency human-spaceflight launch: it flew uncrewed with supplies and repair gear as a lifeboat, returning the Shenzhou 21 crew in May 2026.
summary_zh: 中国载人航天首次应急发射：无人上行运送补给与维修设备，充当救生船，最终于2026年5月将神舟二十一号乘组接回。

source: NASA: International Space Station Visiting Vehicles（2026-10-01 configuration）
summary_en: Delivered the Expedition 73/74 crew to the ISS for an eight-month mission.
summary_zh: 将第73/74远征队乘组送往空间站，在轨8个月后返回。

agency_zh: 中国载人航天工程办公室
source: 中国载人航天工程网：神舟二十三号发射（2026-05-25）及出舱活动（2026-08-28）报道
summary_en: Zhu Yangzhu, Zhang Zhiyuan and Lai Ka-ying arrived at the Chinese space station in May 2026 for science, technology experiments and station maintenance; the crew completed a spacewalk in August.
summary_zh: 朱杨柱、张志远、黎家盈乘组于2026年5月进驻中国空间站，开展科学实验、技术试验与空间站维护，8月完成出舱活动。

source: NASA: International Space Station Visiting Vehicles（2026-10-01 configuration）
summary_en: Currently docked Russian-U.S. crew ferry, planned to return in April 2027.
summary_zh: 目前在轨的俄美联合乘组飞船，计划2027年4月返回。
